abstract: A metastatic seminoma of the right temporal fossa, with facial pain, extraocular paresis, otitis, and abdominal symptoms, was found in a 34-year-old man one year after orchidectomy for a primary testicular tumor that had been treated by surgery and radiotherapy. This is an unusual intracranial metastatic tumor that merits active treatment.
abstract_ja: 精巣原発腫瘍に対し手術と放射線療法を受け、精巣摘除術を施行された34歳男性において、1年後に右側頭窩の転移性セミノーマが認められた。症状は顔面痛、外眼筋麻痺、耳炎、腹部症状であった。本症例は稀な頭蓋内転移腫瘍であり、積極的な治療に値する。
